basic_details.job_title: VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for DEO & Scientist Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Multidisciplinary Research Unit (MRU) of Vardhman Mahavir Medical College & Safdarjung Hospital, New Delhi, funded by the Department of Health Research, has invited applications for Data Entry Operator (1 post), Scientist 'B' (Non-Medical) and Scientist 'C' (Non-Medical) on a contractual basis of six months, extendable. Pay is ₹24,356/- per month for the Data Entry Operator, 56,000/- plus HRA for Scientist 'B' and 67000/- plus HRA for Scientist 'C'. Applications are sent by email, with a Google form to be filled as well, latest by 10/12/2026.

how_to_apply: Fill in your details in the Google form whose link is given in the notice (see the Application Form link below).

Fill the Application Performa printed in the notice (name, post applied for, date of birth, age on the last date, category, gender, nationality, marital status, address, email ID, educational qualifications, experience).
Scan the filled form and combine it with self-attested supporting documents, as per the checklist, in a single PDF, with documents in chronological order (qualification and experience).
Email the PDF to [email protected] latest by 10/12/2026.
Write the position in the email subject as: "Application for the post of ………………………".
Give the details of two responsible persons of your locality, or two references to whom you are known.
Photograph - 2 (on the day of interview/written exam)
important_instructions: No application will be entertained after the last date; incomplete applications (not accompanied by relevant documents) or those received after the due date/time will be summarily rejected. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. Submission of incorrect or false information disqualifies the candidature at any stage of the recruitment process. If a candidate is found not eligible after qualifying, the candidature will be cancelled and, if appointed, services will be terminated without any notice or compensation. Candidates are advised to check the website of the Institute for any change or other information.

content_sections.heading: About the Multidisciplinary Research Unit
content_sections.text: The notice comes from the Office of the Principal, Vardhman Mahavir Medical College & Safdarjung Hospital, New Delhi - 110029, which is affiliated to Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University, Delhi. The posts are for the Multidisciplinary Research Unit (MRU), funded by the Department of Health Research, and are to be filled on a purely temporary basis at the hospital. The posts are contractual, not regular.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The place of posting for all three posts is MRU, VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital, New Delhi. The notice prints no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Age is calculated as on the last date of submission of the application, 10/12/2026. The notice prints no age relaxation. Qualification or degree should be from a reputed Institution/University, and meeting the essential qualification or experience does not guarantee selection. Persons already in regular time scale service under any Government Department/Organizations are not eligible. Knowledge of MS Office, MS Word, MS PowerPoint and MS Excel. Knowledge of maintaining databases, preparing reports and handling confidential data. Knowledge of hospital/clinical research-related documentation. Working experience of more than 2 years in Govt. Institutions/Similar Schemes will be preferred. Ph.D. or 4-year experience in research. Three research Publication in PubMed index Journal. Preference will be given to those who have prior experience of working in Govt. Institutions/Similar Schemes. Five Research publication in Medline/PubMed Indexed Journal with high impact journal. Three years of research and development (R&D) or teaching experience in the relevant field after obtaining the degree. Experience in molecular biology techniques (PCR, Nucleic Acid Extraction, ELISA and quantification assays, molecular diagnostics). Preference will be given to those who have prior experience of working in Govt. Institutions/Similar Schemes. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Intermediate or 12th pass from recognized board. A speed test of not less than 15000 key depressions per hour through speed test on computer.
First Class Post-graduate in Molecular Biology/Medical Biotechnology/Biostatistics

PhD with first Class Post Graduate Degree including the integrated PG degrees (Biotechnology / an equivalent allied discipline) OR PhD and three Years Research Experience with Second Class Post Graduate Degree, including the integrated PG degrees (Biotechnology / an equivalent allied discipline)

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Data Entry Operator gets a consolidated salary of ₹24,356/- per month. The notice says this is as per the DHR guidelines (applicable minimum wages notified by the Govt. of NCT of Delhi that is revised periodically). Scientist 'B' gets a consolidated salary of 56,000/- Plus, HRA as applicable, and Scientist 'C' gets 67000/- + HRA, as admissible. Appointment will be on a contractual basis for six months, extendable for further period subject to satisfactory performance and other considerations up to the Finance Commission Cycle of 5 years. The posts are purely contractual, and the candidate has no right to claim any type of permanent employment under DHR/VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital or continuation of services in any other project. The Institute does not have residential facilities for contractual staff. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview or joining the post.

content_sections.heading: VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Data entry, compilation, verification and maintenance of research-related data and records. Preparation and maintenance of registers, databases, spreadsheets and reports. Assistance in documentation, filing and record management. Coordination with laboratory staff and other associated departments for data collection and reporting. Maintaining confidentiality and accuracy of all project-related information. Any other work assigned by the Nodal Officer from time to time. Knowledge of medical statistics, Computer applications/Data Management, analysis and interpretation of results of statistical analysis. Maintenance of all records and scientific laboratory analysis and execution and supervision of research work including analysis and report writing. Coordination between DHR and MRU and within the institution. Preparation of proposals and any other work assigned by Nodal Officer from time to time. Candidate may be required to do field visits or training or laboratory visits as per requirement. Maintenance of all records and scientific laboratory analysis and execution and supervision of research work including analysis and report writing. Coordination between DHR and MRU and within the institution. Preparation of proposals and any other work assigned by Nodal Officer from time to time. Candidate may be required to do field visits or training or laboratory visits as per requirement.

Email the PDF to [email protected] latest by 10/12/2026. Write the position in the email subject as: "Application for the post of ………………………". Give the details of two responsible persons of your locality, or two references to whom you are known. ID proof (Aadhaar Card/Voters ID/Driving Licence) Class X marksheet/Age proof Class XII marksheet Graduation marksheet/certificate Post Graduate marksheets/certificate PhD marksheet/certificate Any other qualifications Experience (if any) Publication (if any) Photograph - 2 (on the day of interview/written exam)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be informed of the date and time of the interview by email. For the post of Data Entry Operator, candidates will be intimated about the written test, speed test or interview by email. The written test for Data Entry Operator covers basic knowledge of Computer Applications. The notice prints no interview date, venue or marking scheme. At the interview, candidates bring the printed hard copy of the duly filled application form with self-attested supporting documents as per checklist, 2 sets of photocopies of relevant original documents and a recent passport size photo. Original documents are verified at the interview. In the absence of valid original documents, the candidate is not considered eligible.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the VMMC & Safdarjung Hospital MRU posts?
faq.answer: The application must reach by email latest by 10/12/2026 (10 December 2026). Applications after the last date are not entertained.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: The notice prints a number only for Data Entry Operator: 01 (One) post. Scientist 'B' and Scientist 'C' have no number printed.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Data Entry Operator?
faq.answer: Intermediate or 12th pass from a recognized board, with a speed test of not less than 15000 key depressions per hour on computer.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Scientist 'B' and Scientist 'C'?
faq.answer: Scientist 'B' needs a First Class Post-graduate in Molecular Biology/Medical Biotechnology/Biostatistics. Scientist 'C' needs a PhD with first class PG degree, or a PhD with three years' research experience and a second class PG degree (Biotechnology / an equivalent allied discipline).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Not exceeding 30 years for Data Entry Operator, 35 years for Scientist 'B' and 40 years for Scientist 'C', counted as on 10/12/2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary?
faq.answer: Data Entry Operator gets ₹24,356/- per month. Scientist 'B' gets 56,000/- plus HRA as applicable, and Scientist 'C' gets 67000/- + HRA, as admissible.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Fill the Google form, then email the filled Application Performa with self-attested documents as a single PDF to [email protected], with "Application for the post of ………………………" as the subject.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely contractual for six months, extendable up to the Finance Commission Cycle of 5 years, and give no right to permanent employment.

faq.question: Q9. Is HRA paid on top of the Scientist pay?
faq.answer: Yes. Scientist 'B' pay is 56,000/- plus HRA as applicable, and Scientist 'C' pay is 67000/- + HRA, as admissible.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA is paid either for attending the interview or for joining the post.
